details.description: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct is Meta's 8-billion-parameter instruction-tuned chat model, released July 23, 2024 as the smallest of the three Llama 3.1 sizes (8B, 70B, 405B) Meta released together. It is built for assistant-style multilingual dialogue, coding help, and tool use in agentic or retrieval-augmented workflows, and its pretraining data has a cutoff of December 2023. On this catalog entry it has a 16,384-token context window.
advantages: Scores 84.5% on GSM-8K (chain-of-thought) and 72.6% Pass@1 on HumanEval, per Meta's Llama 3.1 model card.
Scores 80.4% on IFEval instruction-following and 82.6% on the API-Bank tool-use benchmark, per Meta's Llama 3.1 model card.
Supports multiple tool-use and function-calling formats through Meta's Transformers chat template, per Meta's model card.
Officially supports 8 languages (English, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi, Spanish, Thai), per Meta's model card.
disadvantages: Pretraining data cutoff of December 2023, per Meta's model card.
The smallest of the three Llama 3.1 sizes Meta released (8B, 70B, 405B); Meta's own benchmark tables show the 70B and 405B models scoring higher on the same tests.
use_cases: Tool use and function calling for agentic workflows

sources.title: Introducing Llama 3.1: Our most capable models to date

notes: Meta's model card states a 128K-token context window for Llama 3.1 8B Instruct generally; this catalog entry gives it a 16,384-token window, which I kept per instructions. Benchmark numbers were cross-checked between Meta's Hugging Face card and its GitHub MODEL_CARD.md and matched exactly.
